'''''Sigma 1''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|''Delta''-class JV-7 escort shuttle]]. It was one of four such shuttles to participate in an Imperial [[Attack on ZA-13|attack]] on the factory [[ZA-13]], which at the time was held by traitorous [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]].<ref name="Defender" />
